name: Coarse-to-Fine Densification
definition: A training strategy where a sparse mesh is progressively refined by inserting centroid vertices for high-scoring triangles and re-running Delaunay triangulation.
summary: Coarse-to-Fine Densification is a training strategy that progressively refines a sparse mesh by inserting vertices at high-error locations, decoupling initialization from refinement to adapt topology to scene complexity.
